COGS vs Budgeted COGS vs Actual Sales (SBU level, BDT crore)

Actual COGS (direct RM/PM issue)Budgeted COGS (GL 4810001)Actual Sales (net order value)

Monthly pivot SBU → Item → month

Qty = issue-to-shop-floor quantity; Value = issue value (BDT); Rate = Value ÷ Qty for that month. Blank cell = no activity. Trend chart (SBU level): Actual COGS = direct RM/PM issue value; Budgeted COGS = approved GL 4810001 budget; Actual Sales = net sales-order value. Definitions differ (actual COGS is materials-only), so use the chart for trend/scale, not as a gross-margin calculation. Budget and sales are SBU-level and not affected by item-level filters. Change columns: based on the last month in range (e.g., Nov-26) — YoY vs same month last year, MoM vs prior month, QoQ vs 3 months earlier — on the selected metric (Value when Metric = All). If the last month is month-to-date, the changes are indicative and normalise once the month closes.

Material plan

MRP (Live) iBOS MRP runs · actual consumption · current stock

Loading live MRP data…
Requirements (C, C+1, C+2) come from the current iBOS MRP run. Shortages use the same rule as Material Planning: current stock minus cumulative requirement (negative = shortage). Average monthly consumption = actual Issue For Shop Floor quantity over the months available in the last 24 months, from the first recorded issue onward, including zero months after that; daily consumption = average / 30. Current stock is the iBOS inventory-ledger balance (sum of all active receipts, issues, transfers and inventory adjustments; negative balances are kept). Coverage = stock / daily consumption; shown as N/A when there is no consumption history or daily consumption is zero. Quantities and UOM follow the MRP run's UOM (with consumption/item-master UOM as fallback), so all columns are consistent.
